coins.title: Coins
coins.description: Hyperliquid perp names, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, XRP, DOGE. Empty = every coin.

topAccounts.title: Accounts to scan
topAccounts.description: The N largest Hyperliquid accounts by account value. 2,000 takes about 90 seconds; more accounts fill in smaller positions.

bucketPct.title: Band width (%)
bucketPct.description: Width of each price band as a percent of the mark price, 0.1-10.

rangePct.title: Range (%)
rangePct.description: Only map liquidations within this percent of the mark price, up and down.

output.title: Output
output.description: Levels = the liquidation map (price bands). Positions = individual positions closest to liquidation.

maxPositions.title: Maximum positions
maxPositions.description: How many positions to list, closest to liquidation first.

maxDistancePct.title: Maximum distance to liquidation (%)
maxDistancePct.description: Positions output only: list only positions within this percent of their liquidation price. Empty = no limit.
